newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia working days lost to strikes falls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia working days lost to strikes falls.

text.p: The number of days lost in Australia due to industrial disputes fell to 27,200 in December from 52,000 in November, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
The number of disputes fell to 48 in December from 52 the previous month, while the number of employees involved fell to 22,900 from 49,300, the bureau said.
The highest number of days lost was in the coal mining industry, which lost 16,200 and education, health, and community services, which lost 6,600.
The total number of days lost in calendar 1996 jumped to 924,500 from 547,600 in 1995, the bureau said.
